summary: Your eleventh Sunday review and the end of Module 6. You answer 9 questions with a confidence number, pick the 3 worst answers of your pipeline with a failure type and a test idea, write the module retrospective, extend your glossary, run it from cold, tag week 11 and plan week 12.
goal: Self-test, error log (3 themes), catch-up slot, plan next week; pick the 3 worst answers.

items.text: Self-test: answer the 9 questions with a 1 to 3 confidence number, then mark each one
Make a table of at least 8 answers and write down the 3 worst with a failure type
Write the Module 6 retrospective, 2 lines for each of 5 questions
Glossary: add 8 new words with a one-line definition and an example
Run it from cold: down, up, ingest, API and one question using only your README
Run git tag week-11, then plan week 12 with one outcome sentence and a drop list
Play the Module 6 Mix-up game to the end and see your score
